\subsection{Morphisms of weak $2$-involutions} \label{appsub:weak2inv}

\begin{definition}
	Let $(K,H,\alpha,\zeta)$ and $(K',H',\alpha',\zeta')$ be two weak $2$-involutions. A $1$-morphism of these is given by
	\begin{enumerate}

		\item an adjoint equivalence $u,u^{.}$ given by the following $2$-cell:

		\[\begin{tikzcd}[ampersand replacement=\&]
			K \&\& {K'} \\
			\\
			K \&\& {K'}
			\arrow["R", from=1-1, to=1-3]

			\arrow["u", between={0.2}{0.8}, Rightarrow, nfold, from=1-3, to=3-1]
			\arrow["{H'}", from=1-3, to=3-3]
			\arrow["R"', from=3-1, to=3-3]
		\end{tikzcd}\cdpunct[8pt]{,}\]
		\item a $3$-cell $\delta$ as depicted by the following diagram:
		% https://q.uiver.app/#
		\[\begin{tikzcd}[ampersand replacement=\&,column sep=small]
			\&\& {K'} \&\&\&\& {K'} \& \\
			\\
			\&\& K \& {K'} \& {\Rrightarrow^{\delta}} \& K \&\& {K'} \\
			K \\
			\& K \& {K'} \&\&\&\& {K'} \\
			\& R \\
			\&\& {(H'H')R} \&\& {1_{K'}R} \&\& R \\
			\& {H'(H'R)} \&\&\&\&\&\& {R1_K} \\
			\& {H'(RH)} \&\&\&\&\&\& {R(HH)} \\
			\&\& {(H'R)H} \&\&\&\& {(RH)H}
			\arrow["u", between={0.2}{0.8}, Rightarrow, nfold, from=1-3, to=3-3]

			\arrow["{H'}", from=3-8, to=5-7]
			\arrow["R", from=4-1, to=1-3]
			\arrow["H"{description}, from=4-1, to=3-3]

		\item a $3$-cell $\omega$ as depicted by the following diagram:

			\arrow["\gamma", between={0.2}{0.8}, Rightarrow, nfold, from=2, to=3]

		\item the $3$-cell $\omega$ satisfy the weak $2$-involution $2$-morphism axiom (\cref{app:weak2inv2morph}).

\end{definition}

\begin{definition}

			\arrow[""{name=3, anchor=center, inner sep=0}, "\lambda1"{description}, curve={height=30pt}, from=3-1, to=3-3]
			\arrow["\lambda1"', from=3-5, to=3-7]

			\arrow["\upsilon", between={0.2}{0.8}, Rightarrow, nfold, from=2, to=3]
		\end{tikzcd}\cdpunct[8pt]{.}\]
	\end{enumerate}
\end{definition}
